title: Answer: consciousness is the capacity for phenomenal experience, however minimal, studied as information exchange

statements.text: The framework uses awareness and consciousness to mean the capacity for phenomenal experience, however basic or minimally structured, and treats it as a property a system may have whatever it experiences: it is enough that some experience occurs. It sets aside what consciousness is ontologically, taking the hard problem as a set of intuitions to be overcome rather than a problem to solve, and asks instead what follows from the assumption that consciousness involves information exchange under the constraints of quantum information theory.
statements.scope: Minimal physicalism as a scale-free substrate for cognition and consciousness (2021) and A free energy principle for generic quantum systems (2021)
